member.name: T:LendingPlatform.Api.Services.LoanDecisionService
member.summary:
Implements the lending policy rules and produces a loan decision.
Rule evaluation order: 1. Minimum loan amount 2. Maximum loan amount 3. High-value loan (≥ £1,000,000) 4. Standard loan bands (LTV-based)
LTV is calculated as (LoanAmount / AssetValue) × 100 and stored as a percentage value (e.g. 50 represents 50 %). The unrounded value is used for all rule comparisons.
